title: Form One Mathematics Learning Activities
purpose: Provide structured activities that enable learners to discover, practise, apply and demonstrate mathematical competencies.

learning_activities.title: Numbers in Our Community
learning_activities.instructions: Identify at least ten examples of numbers in your home, school or community.
tasks: Record numbers found on clocks, calendars and classroom doors.
Identify numbers used in counting money and measuring quantities.
Classify the numbers as natural numbers, whole numbers or integers where applicable.
Explain two ways numbers are useful in everyday life.

learning_activities.title: The Mathematics Market
learning_activities.instructions: Simulate a market transaction using imaginary Tanzanian shillings.
learning_activities.scenario: A learner purchases three exercise books at TZS 2,000 each and two pens at TZS 1,000 each.
tasks: Calculate the cost of the exercise books.
Calculate the cost of the pens.
Determine the total amount spent.
Calculate the change from TZS 10,000.

learning_activities.title: Fractions in Daily Life
learning_activities.instructions: Use drawings or paper shapes to demonstrate fractions.
tasks: Divide a paper rectangle into two equal parts.
Shade one-half.
Divide another rectangle into four equal parts and shade three-quarters.
Explain the meaning of numerator and denominator.
Compare one-half and three-quarters.
expected_evidence: Correct identification of numerator and denominator

learning_activities.title: Algebra Around Us
learning_activities.instructions: Translate everyday statements into algebraic expressions.
tasks: Represent a number using the variable x.
Express five more than a number.
Express three times a number.
Evaluate 3x + 5 when x = 4.
Explain what the variable represents.

learning_activities.title: Classifying Sets
learning_activities.instructions: Use diagrams to organise objects into sets.
tasks: Create a set of even numbers below 12.
Create a set of odd numbers below 12.
Identify elements common to both sets.
Represent the sets using appropriate notation.
Explain the meaning of union and intersection.

learning_activities.title: Geometry Hunt
learning_activities.instructions: Identify geometric shapes and angles in your surroundings.
tasks: Identify three rectangular objects.
Find examples of parallel lines.
Identify right angles.
Draw a triangle and a quadrilateral.
Describe one property of each shape.

learning_activities.title: Measure Your Classroom
learning_activities.instructions: Use a measuring tape or ruler to investigate classroom measurements.
tasks: Measure the length of the classroom.
Measure its width.
Convert the measurements into centimetres.
Calculate the classroom perimeter.
Calculate the area using the rectangular model.

learning_activities.title: Mixing Quantities
learning_activities.scenario: A mixture uses two cups of water for every one cup of juice concentrate.
tasks: Write the water-to-concentrate ratio.
Calculate the quantities needed for six cups of concentrate.
Determine the total quantity of the mixture.
Explain why the ratio remains constant.

learning_activities.title: Classroom Data Investigation
learning_activities.instructions: Collect and organise simple information from classmates.
tasks: Choose a simple survey question.
Collect responses from at least ten learners.
Organise responses into a frequency table.
Construct a bar chart.
Write three observations from the collected data.

learning_activities.title: The Coordinate Treasure Hunt
learning_activities.instructions: Use a coordinate grid to locate specified points.
tasks: Draw a Cartesian coordinate plane.
Label the horizontal and vertical axes.
Plot (2, 3).
Plot (4, 1).
Plot (3, 5).
Explain how ordered pairs identify positions.

questions: What mathematical skill did I practise?
Where can I apply this knowledge?
